payload.title: Accept canonical complete living-report final status
payload.description:
As an operator, I want a successfully published living optimization Report to reach a consistent terminal state, so that its cover content and dashboard lifecycle never disagree.

Feature: Living optimization Report finalization

Scenario: Canonical complete status finalizes a published Report
Given a living optimization Report has a durable final revision
When the orchestrator finalizes the run with status complete
Then the Report and Task are marked terminal without an exception
And the stored final status is canonical and consistent

Scenario: Unsupported terminal status remains rejected
Given a living optimization Report exists
When finalization receives an unknown status
Then finalization fails before changing the Report or Task

Excludes changes to score data, infrastructure resources, or Amplify schema.
